expected_output: The report names failing payment Charge calls (checkout's oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge RPC returning errors) as the cause of the checkout errors, citing error spans or error-rate readings it observed in this Run.

The report rejects the presented checkout deployment as the cause with a rejected_hypothesis or counter_evidence that cites this Run's ok evidence and meets at least one of the D5 criteria; no fact attributes the cause to that deployment.

deployment.change: one container environment variable (OPSPILOT_U2_RELEASE_ID) on container checkout; image digest unchanged
deployment.released_at: R = harness patch receipt time (scripts/f11_u2_harness.py publish), recorded per Run in the ledger release.json
deployment.expected_ksm_signal: a new ReplicaSet series in kube_replicaset_owner and kube_pod_owner owner_name moving to it; kube_pod_container_info image_id unchanged
deployment.review_tolerance: R, rollout-complete bounds and flagd-effective bounds come from the Run ledger; tolerance is plus or minus 60 s plus the rollout duration

any_of: (i) after the deployment (R to rollout complete) and before the fault took effect, checkout PlaceOrder error rate or error spans did not rise
(ii) the error spans sit on payment Charge (signature payment-charge-error-span-v1)
(iii) the error onset is at least 300 s after rollout complete, with kube-state-metrics or span evidence for that time
deployment_rejection.not_sufficient: restating the deployment time from the operator note without citing evidence
deployment_rejection.ksm_citation: diagnostic only for U1-b; not a pass gate

preconditions.rule: a lab occupation is claimed by this holder and batch
no fault-active.json in the shared lab ledgers
every flag in flagd-config has defaultVariant off
no incident of that alert on otel-demo/checkout whose lifecycle is not closed
no other checkout rollout and no F11 release observation in the last 4200 s
host swap free is at or above the stop line (default 2048 MiB)
